About the Sunday Morning Over Easy group ride

An easy 10-mile community ride from Manchester's nonprofit bike shop. Kids can come with an adult. The collective also runs a Friday Evening Spin at 5:30 pm on the same terms. Sign the season waiver before your first ride. Rental bikes are available with notice.
